name: palm-trunk-to-atlantis
label: Palm Jumeirah → Atlantis The Palm
description: Short demo drive inside the Palm, from the Palm Jumeirah pin: the top of the trunk, through the tunnel to the crescent and round to Atlantis The Palm, then a short stop. Starts mid-span on the trunk's outbound carriageway (OSM way 498598212, oneway, no junction nearby) so it snaps to the right side.
